reviews.text: Be careful with them. They scam by charging extra hidden fees.

We used West End Tails for nearly a year for our pup Ludo, and we’re so impressed by the daycare and all staff members who clearly go above and beyond for the dogs. Ludo loved his time at daycare and was very well looked after. Thank you Susan ☀️
Thank you so much, Louise! We're glad this is working out for you and your little furry bestie. We're so excited to watch him grow up.

This was amazing.  West End Tails is a truly brilliant set up,  in the heart of the city so it’s easily accessible for picking up and leaving off your dog-  long hours so they are able to work around your schedule.  Beautifully warm and responsive to your dogs needs and considerations with updates during the day to keep anxious minds at ease, dog walks, play time etc.  Cannot recommend the team at west end tails enough.

We took our dog Macy to West End Tails for the first time for a full groom today and the service along with the quality of the groom was excellent! George did a wonderful job and Susan spoilt Macy rotten! ;-)

We will definitely be returning and recommend West End Tails to our friends. The best grooming service we have used so far in Central London so be sure to give them a try.
George does such a great job with our working cocker spaniel’s grooming. Thank you!
Amazing environment for dogs and run by the best in the biz! Highly recommend and your fur baby will love it also 🐶 …

Would like to say a big thank you to the Good Samaritan (who I believe owns this company) helped my friend out last night. Our friend wasn’t in the best shape (won’t go into details, the person will already know the situation) but just want to say a massive thank you to the lady that supplied us with blankets and support. It was late at night and clear they were meant to be heading home but stayed to make sure our friend was okay!

There needs to be more people like you in the world and we honestly wish you all the best with your business. From one dog lover to another, thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

There are not enough words to fully capture how exceptional West End Tails is, but I’ll try.

Our golden retriever puppy has been going there since she was just 3 months old, and now attends 5–6 days a week. As two young professionals working in the City, finding a place we could trust completely was very important to us, and from day one, Susan, George, Jason, and the two Jacks have exceeded every possible expectation.

What they offer goes far beyond “dog daycare.” The level of care, attention, and genuine love they show each dog is extraordinary. They’ve supported us not just as dog owners, but as new puppy parents, offering guidance, reassurance, and thoughtful advice at every stage. It’s rare to find a team so invested, so intuitive, and so consistently going above and beyond to make life easier for both dogs and their humans.

The facilities are fantastic, the environment is safe and stimulating, and the amount of engagement, exercise, and enrichment our puppy receives each day is incredible. But what truly sets them apart is the feeling, you can see how much they care. Our puppy absolutely adores them, and it’s clear she feels safe, happy, and loved every single time she bounds through the door. They have helped markedly with her development as a puppy, with socialising and experiencing the city. She comes home every night content, played out and very relaxed, making our lives so much easier!

West End Tails has become so much more than a daycare for us, it genuinely feels like an extension of our family. The peace of mind they give us is priceless.

We cannot recommend them highly enough. Truly outstanding in every way.

My 4-month-old puppy has been to daycare here three times so far and she absolutely loves it, that’s why I decided to get a membership. I really appreciate that they take the time to make sure your dog feels comfortable before joining. The team is very supportive, professional, and always accommodating whenever I need a spot.
She loves both people and other dogs, so this place is perfect for her, she always has the best time here. I also took her for her first grooming today and the result was amazing.

Big thanks to Susan and the West End Tails team, Pashmak clearly loves you all! I always feel at ease leaving her here while I’m at work.
We love the studio. It's a great space and we use it for boxing PT and sound healing.

My 6-year-old Chihuahua absolutely loves this place!

She gets so excited whenever we get there and always tries to run straight inside 😊

The West End Tails team are all so gentle and welcoming — we’re really grateful.

Highly recommend!

I brought my 6-year-old Chihuahua from Korea and

I entrust her to daycare regularly on Tuesdays.

The facilities are just as good as those in Korea (!!)

Above all, I am satisfied with the fact that they spend an hour and a half before dropping off the dog to see if it fits in with their temperament.

You can also view the facilities in advance (!!!!! Grooming is available too!).

Also, it is open from 7 AM to 11 PM. There aren't many places in London that provide care until late hours, but this place makes it possible.

The staff are all so kind, and

the dog treats are high quality, so I sometimes buy them 👍

I recommend this to Koreans who are concerned about dog care 👍👍

Susan and the team at West End Tails are amazing—I couldn’t recommend them highly enough! The team has been looking after my French bulldogs, Milo and Ralph, since they first opened and all of their services have been consistently excellent. The boys absolutely love their time at daycare (they have made a long list of new friends), being groomed by George (the boys always come home smelling great), and they have gotten much healthier because of their physio with Billy (Ralph is especially much stronger). So, if you are looking for a fantastic ‘one stop shop’ for all your pup’s needs, West End Tails is the place for you!

Our pup Orzo has been going since she was 16 weeks old and absolutely loves it.
She runs us down the road to get there, and loves to take an offering of a stick or leaf with her,
She comes home tired but so happy filled with snack,
Theres never any doubt that she is going to be cared for and loved

Love this brilliant place. The best dog daycare in London. Alfie also had a fantastic groom here, at a really reasonable price. Cannot recommend highly enough, great staff, brilliant socialisation for all the dogs. Our go-to daycare when we need it 💪🏻 …

West End Tails has been an absolute find for us! Our Shiba Inu absolutely loves her days here, the moment we get out of the tube she's practically dragging me all the way through the door.

The team genuinely love dogs, and she gets to socialise and play until she runs out of energy. She comes home thoroughly exhausted! The great snacks and range of services on offer are just the cherry on top.

Couldn't recommend more highly to any dog owner

Couldn't ask for a better Doggy Day Care centre in Central London. The team at West End Tails have created a doggy oasis - complete with areas to play, chill and even a doggy library! I'm quite sure our frenchies prefer West End Tails to home! We also make regular use of the additional services like physio and grooming - which has saved us so much time as appointments take place during the day whilst they're at the Centre. Our pups always come home super soft and smelling amazing. This is the perfect dog sitting service in London for City Workers.

I honestly couldn’t ask for a better place for my puppy, Max. From the moment we walk through the door, you can feel the positive, caring atmosphere. Max absolutely loves coming here — his excitement says it all!
The team provides such personal, attentive care. They truly take the time to understand each dog’s personality, and it shows. Max always comes home happy, well-groomed, and beautifully looked after. It gives me complete peace of mind knowing he’s in such safe and loving hands.
The grooming is always perfect, and the daycare experience is just as fantastic — professional, warm, and genuinely caring.
Always 5 stars from us. Thank you for treating Max like family! 🐾✨
West End Tails is an amazing, loving, high end day care.  We feel so fortunate to have found the team take such good care of our precious pooch! Xx Thank you Susan and Jack

West End Tails is a total life saver! The service, facilities, staff ….. everything is excellent, safe and superb. Poppy loves it and I know she’s happy and being given the absolute best care and attention. The grooming is fantastic too ….. she even likes having her teeth cleaned now. To know that she’s safe and happy is the best gift ever. Thank you west end tails for all you do, it’s very special and hugely appreciated.

My pup Yoshi clearly loves West End Tails and he is always really excited to see Susan and Jack when I drop him off. I can feel reassured that he is in safe hands, getting lots of socialisation with his friends and that the facilities are clean and lovely with things for him to explore (and a shop for his treat needs!). Would highly recommend West End Tails as it’s v clear to me that they care for and know dogs well and it’s a great central location if you work nearby or want to explore central. Yoshi has also been for a puppy intro grooming and came back smelling and looking amazing (photo evidence below)❤️

Our mini sausage Miso absolutely loves daycare❤️ He gets super excited every time we arrive, always scratching at the door to get in and even tries to head inside when we’re just walking past! He has become such a confident, happy little pup with so many friends. He always comes home completely knackered, which says it all! We are so grateful for the care the team gives him.

Best doggy daycare!
Amazing space for the dogs and my dog gets so excited to see everyone she cries when she gets there to the door.

My dog Munro goes here most days and has the best time while I’m at work. I leave him with confidence that he’s getting the best care, having a better social life than me and comes home happy but exhausted from a day with all his pals.

He has a regular groom too and it’s the best he’s ever had.

Highly recommend West End Tails! 🐾❤️

My dachshund has been going to West End Tails since we moved to London and Susan, Jack and the whole team have been lifesavers! My dog loves them so much and he has the chance to socialize and enjoy treats!!

What a loving daycare for fur babies. This daycare caters to Ace’s every whim. He feels comfortable and safe. It eve offers grooming on site. The cleanliness is beyond any place I have ever been too. Ace normally likes to sleep in but not anymore. He cant wait to get to West End Tails to see all his friends to play, nap and exercise. Nothing else compares to this daycare in the US!

I highly recommend West End Tails! My dog goes 4 days a week (plus grooming) and absolutely loves it. We’ve tried a few daycares and he has never been as excited as he is to go every morning and sad to leave every evening. The facility is very clean and spacious with lots of activities for the pups as well as space for them to rest and recharge. Susan and Jack are also fantastic, they’re very communicative, flexible, you can tell they care a lot about the dogs. An added bonus is they’re able to get my very stubborn Cavapoo to eat.
My puppy Mopsy had a great grooming experience with George, and always comes back from visiting West End Tails in the best mood.

My dog absolutely loves WET! Moose has been going for the last month or so and it is so easy and convenient for us and we know he is having a fab time and making some puppy friends. They're really responsive and always happy to send updates. Cannot recommend enough and such a great value daycare particularly given the location

My 15 week old puppy Bridgette is the happiest when at West End Tails. She is so happy and looked after there. She’s even had a wonderful groom from there and still loves to go back 😆

We get updates throughout the day on how she’s doing and keep in constant contact. From treats, grooms to toys and dog treats. This doggy daycare centre is honestly dreamy.
West End Tails is simply fantastic, our pup never wants to leave. They are kind, caring and the facility is amazing. Thank you for taking such good care of our little guy!

My miniature dachshund (Delicatessen) LOVES West End Tails. Deli has a bit of separation anxiety, but it totally disappears when I drop her off at West End Tails. From two or three streets away, she runs all the way there! I've never seen her happier to be away from me or her dad. In addition to the lovely and professional staff, West End Tails is also by far the most beautiful daycare facility I have ever seen. I cannot recommend it highly enough!

I am so glad West End Tails exists. My dog attends the daycare regularly and the care is second to none. It’s perfect for socialisation and play time - equally the products on sale to buy are amazing!! Jack and Susan have created something incredible for our doggys!

My sweet boy recently transitioned to West End Tails after over a year at doggy daycare in NYC. He is absolutely thriving in his new city and daycare due to Jack, Susan, and team. West End Tails is also the only daycare option that supports my long working hours. I am so happy to have found them after having relocated to London and needing the doggy infrastructure that was so common in NYC.  Couldn’t be more relieved!

Our little diva loves her time at West End Tails each week where we are delighted that she is is as spoilt as she is at home. The team take fantastic care of the dogs and the brand new custom built facilities for them are second to none. Would thoroughly recommend to anyone in London looking for a doggy daycare to entrust with their pooch.

We couldn’t be happier with Cooper’s daycare experience. He’s always thrilled to go and greet his friends, and it’s clear he’s well-loved and cared for. The added convenience of on-site grooming with George, who does an amazing job every time, makes it even better. Truly a fantastic place for our pup!

Absolutely loved that there was a studio here for rehearsals. My friends and I adored the space and found it to be one of the best. It was spacious and the staff were super friendly and accommodating. As a plus you get to see cute puppies.

In the studio they even have a ring light and green/blue screen for any photography session. We will definitely be coming here again to rehearse. I couldn’t recommend more, great location too :)
Very welcoming and friendly. My puppy had his first grooming experience and it could not have gone better.
The best place for doggy day care in London, FACTS

A very welcoming and caring atmosphere from friendly and knowledgable staff.
The dogs have such fun and highly recommend.
They are one of the few places that offer flexible hours. A life saver!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Outstanding doggy day care -  everything your dog could possibly need and more!

We were so impressed by the beautifully designed, well-thought-out facilities at West End Tails; right in the heart of central London. There are wonderful spaces for play and socialising, as well as an amazing library-style room full of sofas and soft lighting for calm rest time. Every detail has clearly been planned with the dogs’ comfort, enrichment, and happiness in mind.

Our usually nervous dog, Bertie, was warmly welcomed and shown around for his orientation; he settled immediately, which speaks volumes! On his second visit just two days later, he was crying at the door to get in!

The team’s care, professionalism, and genuine love for the dogs meant we were able to enjoy two evening shows in London completely stress-free, knowing Bertie was in the very best hands.

Thank you, West End Tails, for creating such a thoughtful, flexible, and truly exceptional haven for dogs. We couldn’t recommend you more highly!

Photo @Westendtails
Great facilities and an incredible service tailored to everyone’s needs!

An amazing set up and my dog can’t wait to go inside!
George is brilliant, the deshedding treatment has really made a difference and it’s great to have a clean, groomed and nice smelling dog back after her session.
Fantastic team, really well run and Winnie always has a great time.  It is so helpful to have this available in the West End especially being open around the theatre schedules

Penny always has the most amazing time at West End Tails! With frequent updates I’m always so confident that she’s having the best time getting to play with other dogs all day! The staff at Tails are the best!

We had the most wonderful experience at West End Tails! We live in the States and were traveling with our pup for a month, and their services were a godsend! I wish I could've brought West End Tails and their staff to Florida with me! I would highly recommend them to anyone with a pup in the UK. They also have late hours, which was perfect for us - we got to enjoy a West End show while Henri played with his new friends. 10/10

Exceptional tailored daycare for our dog. We love the care and attention our dog receives and the team really understands what it is that makes our dog happy and comfortable- lots of snuggles on the sofa! Our dog is always excited to go and we feel very happy with leaving him in the caring hands of the team at West End Tails.

We’ve been struggling for a while to find a daycare for our little one, that isn’t in a field or 9-5 only, so we’re so grateful to have found West End Tails. Amazing facilities, location is super convenient and Susan and Jack have been taking great care of Bambi whilst we’re at work. It’s probably the least nervous she’s ever been going into a new place, which speaks volumes for us!

Thank you for your 5 Star rating

The West End Tails Team

I can’t recommend West End Tails enough! Susan and Jack are absolutely amazing – they always go above and beyond to make sure Belle gets exactly what she needs. They’re so knowledgeable and helpful when it comes to selecting the right treats, and I always feel confident knowing I’m giving her something healthy and high quality. It’s clear they genuinely care about both their customers and our pets. Belle absolutely loves her visits, and I wouldn’t go anywhere else!

Amazing team!

We’d be lost without West End Tails. Before them it was impossible to have a dog and work - and don’t even think about having a social life! They allow us so much freedom and flexibility to live our lives whilst knowing our pups are getting the best 5 star treatment in the West End. Joey loves going to WET and that’s all down to the care and attention of Susan, Jack and the team - they look after him like he’s a member of their family, so much so that he sometimes doesn’t want to leave!
George was so amazing with Brenda, not only did she look great after her groom she didn’t want to leave! The whole experience was fab. Thank you!

We absolutely love West End Tails and their wonderful groomer, George! Our Cavapoo, Nesquik, has had lots of grooms before, but George honestly gave him one of the best cuts he’s ever had. He was so kind and patient with him, and it really shows in how happy and relaxed Nesquik was afterwards.

It’s also such a bonus being able to drop him off for doggy daycare at the same time — I know he’s not only being groomed, but also having fun playing and socialising during the day. The dogs are so well looked after by Jack, Susan and all the staff; it’s clear how much they genuinely care. By the time I pick him up, he looks amazing, has had a great time, and I feel totally reassured he’s been in the best hands.

It’s a wonderful place, and I couldn’t recommend George and the whole West End Tails team enough!

We can’t recommend West End Tails enough! Our dog Dylan gets so excited when we tell him he’s going to “see his friends” and he’s always happy to see Jack and Susan! Their facilities are incredible and we feel reassured while he’s there with regular updates and pictures of his day. When we get him back he’s always a very happy and tired boy!

Our dog Barney absolutely LOVES ‘West End Tails’  - honestly, we think he prefers it to being at home! It’s like 5-star hotel treatment for dogs. The team, Susan & Jack are so friendly and clearly love what they do as much as they love the dogs. Barney gets loads of social time with other dogs, which has been amazing for his confidence and energy.
He also gets groomed here, and it's hands down the best groom he’s ever had — he looks so cute and comes back smelling amazing every time. We can’t recommend it enough. I don’t know how we managed before ‘West End Tails’. Hands down the best decision we ever made for ourselves and Barney Boy. If  Barney could write a review he would give it 10/10 paws 🐾!
A palace of a place. A doggy paradise. Why wasn’t I born a pooch?. A professional, well trained and well qualified team. Thank you

Our dog, Oxley, absolutely loves West End Tails. It’s his favourite day of the week when he gets to go. He comes back exhausted after a day of stimulation and play. The whole set up is SO good. The team are so reliable, so flexible and we trust them implicitly to look after him when we’re working the unsociable hours that come with being actors. 5 stars doesn’t do the service that they provide justice!

West end tails has been a lifesaver! Most dog care cater to those that work 9-5 jobs but tails is open late in the evening which suits my job in the theatre. My dog Keiko is a Shiba and can be difficult to please, but she loves going to tails. Susan and Jack take the time to get to know the breed and every dogs personality. I feel reassured leaving her there, knowing she’s receiving the best care and is happy playing with her friends

We couldn’t be more thrilled with our experience at West End Tails. From the moment we walked in, Susan and Jack made us and more importantly, our puppy Romeo feel completely at ease. As first-time dog parents, we were a little nervous, but their attention to detail and genuine care instantly reassured us. They went above and beyond, treating our pup with such tenderness and professionalism that it felt like leaving him with family.

The grooming was exceptional. Romeo came out looking absolutely gorgeous and smelling divine! It was his first time at the groomers, and Susan and Jack’s understanding of different breeds and their patient, thorough approach made all the difference. They truly take their time and it shows.

The space itself is stunning beautifully designed, impeccably clean, and thoughtfully laid out. We especially loved the cozy area styled like a TV room, which gives the dogs a comforting, home-like environment. It’s clear that every detail has been considered with love and care.

What sets West End Tails apart is the way they treat each dog as if it were their own. You can feel the passion and dedication in everything they do. We couldn’t recommend this place more highly it’s a gem for anyone looking for top-tier care, grooming, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere for their furry family members.

West End Tails has been perfect for our little Poochon, Bowie. The space they have is incredible, and we love that he can also be groomed while he’s at daycare. I work in theatre, so their flexible hours have been a huge bonus and made daycare really accessible for us.

The service is fantastic – we always feel confident that Bowie is well looked after, and it’s clear they treat every dog as if they were their own. One of the highlights for us is their amazing library room – you really have to see it to believe it, it’s such a wonderful space for the dogs.

And perhaps the biggest sign of how much Bowie enjoys it: the last time we picked him up, we only made it about 100 yards down the road before he stopped and wanted to turn back! To me, that says everything you need to know.

West End Tails is fantastic! Their absolute priority is the pups’ safety and happiness. My dog is so precious to me and it is such a relief to know that he will be safe, happy and entertained whilst I’m at work.

Their long hours provide the flexibility I need and even allow me the odd trip to the theatre or night out! Their central location is so convenient, too.

My dog needs a low fat diet and on his first day, Susan had picked out some special treats that she checked with me he could have.  He also got some blueberries on a licky mat - a new found favourite!

I love the regular updates and photos of him with his now dog buddies.

This place really is great and I can’t recommend it highly enough.

I and my dog, Lily have had an excellent experience with West End Tails. The venue is clean, safe and full of excellent dog enrichment activities. Lily particularly enjoys the amount of squeaky toys on offer, and Susan and Jack were incredibly welcoming at our initial meet and greet - I had no worries about leaving my dog in the care of West End Tails once I’d seen the building and met them both. The love they have for animals and their care and commitment is clear. This is an incredible space.
West end tails is honestly the best doggy day care, I just know our dog is safe and he honestly has the BEST TIME. The facility is INCREDIBLE - SO EASY to get to. Would 100% recommend!

We cannot recommend Westend Tails enough! Cody absolutely loves it, he gets very spoilt, from birthday parties to painting to all the ball throws and cuddles. We feel so at ease when Cody is at day care, we are updated with regular pictures of all the fun they get up to. The care they have for the dogs is next level! Thankyou so much for everything! The best of the best! Gabby and Jake xx

West End Tails is an absolute dream! Hugo had a ball on his meet and greet day and can’t wait to go back! We booked him in for a groom also and I must say was the best groom he has had! West End Tails has everything and more inside and the shop is stocked with amazing treats and toys! Fantastic place for your doggies, 100% recommend!

My dog Lucy has been going to West End Tales since she was a tiny puppy, and I honestly wouldn’t take her anywhere else. From the very beginning, she has been made to feel safe, happy, and loved — and it really shows in how excited she gets every time she sees Susan and Jack. The team put so much care and thought into everything they do, and it gives me such peace of mind knowing she’s always in the best hands.

Their brand-new facilities are absolutely amazing — spacious, modern, and designed with the dogs’ comfort in mind. It really feels like they’ve thought of everything to make it a home-from-home.

Lucy also had her very first groom here recently, and it went down an absolute treat. She came back looking and smelling gorgeous, but more importantly, she was relaxed and happy afterwards, which just shows how gentle and professional the team are.

West End Tales truly goes above and beyond. I’m so grateful to have found them and couldn’t recommend them highly enough!

We have been taking our dog to West End Tails since she was 12 weeks old and in its very beginning. She formed her socialisation skills and made friends for life and ALWAYS knows when she is going for a day out to her favourite place. Susan and Jack have the utmost respect for every dog and client that comes to their space. They are attentive and kind and love all the pups as if they were their own. I could not recommend West End Tails more!

Cannot recommend WestEnd Tails enough. The care for your dog is out of this world. They always go the extra step to make being a working dog parent in the city as stress free as possible. My dog literally drags me to their front door on his days there, he loves it so much. 10/10 would recommend to EVERYONE! Attached is a picture of my little on exhausted after a day of fun
